text:
Sam K.: deploy-bot just blocked the rc-12 rollout, vuln scan reported a new transitive medium CVE in a test dependency. need quick decision on pin vs scoped rollout :thinking_face:

deploy-bot: [automated] release/rc-12 blocked by policy 'vuln-threshold-medium' on artifact api-server:sha256:abcd1234. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/scan/rc-12

Jordan L.: can someone paste the exact path? is this in the runtime path or only in dev/test?

Asha R.: looks transitive via build-tool -> foo-lib@1.3.4 -> vulnerable-parser. It's pulled by our test-utils only, not the runtime. I ran a quick grep: `packages/*/package-lock.json` shows it referenced in test-utils.

Ivan P. (Security): if it's test-only and cannot be reached from prod runtime we can consider an exception for the release. Need attestation from eng and a short mitigation plan (monitoring + patch plan). Also prefer canary-only to limit exposure.

Sam K.: proposal: 1) pin the deploy to previous known-good digest for prod (sha256:abcdef99) 2) do an EU-only canary with current image and 2h monitoring, 3) legal-approved release notes blurb if we ship under exception. Thoughts? :eyes:

Mika (Legal): legal fine with a short note saying "Scoped exception for test-dependency CVE; no customer data paths affected" if security signs off. We'll also need the release notes text before deploy.

Jordan L.: sounds good. operationally we can do `deploy-bot pin --service api-server --to-sha sha256:abcdef99 --env prod` to keep prod safe, then `deploy-bot deploy --service api-server --image sha256:abcd1234 --regions eu --canary 5% --monitor 2h --note "test-dep-exception"` for the EU canary.

Asha R.: I'll run a quick smoke and attach logs to the ticket. Adding `integration-tests` and `smoke` results to the incident thread.

Ivan P. (Security): I approve the EU canary under these constraints, provided Asha uploads smoke results and we have an agreed rollback signal (error-rate > 0.5% OR p50 latency +20% for 2 consecutive 1m windows).

Sam K.: rollback signal acknowledged. Mika, here's draft release-note line: "Scoped security exception: test-only dependency flagged. No production codepaths affected; monitoring and patch planned." OK to paste into notes?

Mika (Legal): approved. paste it into the release notes field when you trigger the canary. :+1:

Jordan L.: executing ops steps now. pinning prod and queuing EU canary with 5% traffic. command run: `deploy-bot pin --service api-server --to-sha sha256:abcdef99 --by SamK` then `deploy-bot deploy --service api-server --image sha256:abcd1234 --regions eu --canary 5% --monitor 120m --notes "Scoped security exception: test-only dependency flagged. No production codepaths affected; monitoring and patch planned." --requested-by SamK`
deploy-bot: ack. Prod pin applied (api-server -> sha256:abcdef99). EU canary queued to eu-1 cluster, 5% traffic. Monitoring hooks enabled. Ticket: https://tickets.internal/RC-12-SEC-EXC

Asha R.: smoke tests started, will post results in ~10m.

Sam K.: thanks all. we'll hold full rollout until 2h after canary finishes and no rollback signals. If we see issues we'll rollback prod pin to previous and pause any further rollout.

Jordan L.: noted. pinging #sre and #observability to watch dashboards. :bell:

deploy-bot: canary started at 1749994380. will report state updates to this thread.
